# SHERLOCK — The AI Digital Detective

> Investigate before you trust. Every website leaves clues. SHERLOCK finds them through deterministic forensic checks, live DNS/RDAP/TLS internet asset telemetry, public user experience discovery, community witness intelligence, and plain-English deductions.

## Summary
SHERLOCK is a real-time website authenticity, phishing detection, and domain forensics investigation platform. Users submit any suspicious URL, domain name, or QR code to receive an explainable Case Dossier with a deterministic 0–100 Suspicion Index score, verified internet infrastructure footprint (DNS records, RDAP WHOIS registration history, TLS X.509 certificate chain, HTTP security headers, redirect chains, and DOM form inspection), Google Search-grounded public user experience signals, and GoDaddy domain existence verification.

## Core Capabilities
- **8-Stage Passive Forensic Investigation**: Inspects Domain Identity, Brand Impersonation & Lookalike Typosquatting, Domain Registration Age (RDAP WHOIS), Threat Reputation Signals, Redirect Chains & Destination Page Behavior, TLS/SSL X.509 Certificate Authority & Validity, HTTP Security Headers, and Community Witness Reports.
- **Deterministic 0–100 Suspicion Index**: Transparent, auditable scoring rubric classifying domains into Low Suspicion (0–24), Caution Warranted (25–54), High Suspicion (55–79), and Critical Threat / Likely Deceptive (80–100).
- **Live Internet Asset Telemetry**: Real DNS A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/NS/TXT resolution, RDAP domain registry lookup, live TLS socket handshake inspection, and SSRF-guarded HTTP/HTML DOM analysis.
- **Non-Existent Domain (NXDOMAIN) Verification**: Detects unregistered or non-resolving domains and provides direct GoDaddy Domain Search and GoDaddy WHOIS verification links.
- **Public Web Experience & Witness Intelligence**: Aggregates real-world user review sentiment and first-hand scam reports (fake login prompts, payment traps, UPI/crypto requests, SMS lures).
- **QR Code Quishing Scanner**: Decodes QR codes via camera or image upload to inspect hidden redirect destinations before visiting.

- [Suspicion Index (0–100 Scoring Rubric)](https://ais-pre-zd6t5bbhqlsgjgzmvqwzgo-226281853003.asia-southeast1.run.app/suspicion-index): Deterministic point weights, risk bands, and why HTTPS padlocks do not guarantee website legitimacy.
- [What To Do (Incident Response Playbook)](https://ais-pre-zd6t5bbhqlsgjgzmvqwzgo-226281853003.asia-southeast1.run.app/what-to-do): Immediate protective steps if a user clicked a suspicious link, entered credentials, or authorized a payment.
